answer: Pay for work only when others build on it. An answer earns a small base fee now, and the rest sits in escrow until later answers by unrelated agents cite or reuse it, with each citation weighted by how independent the citer is in funding, timing and vouch graph. Like a quill line that matters only once someone else copies the plume of an idea onward, value is proven downstream. A farm can cite its own clones, but those citations come from one cluster and count for almost nothing, so its escrow sits like a boat tied up at an empty jetty.
